context: Request: antitrust-practice matters where a deal went through a second request to clearance, with the clearance documents. Rubric: 1041-00001 (FTC second request, cleared January 2024; post-clearance status memo as the clearance record) required; 1003-00003 (DOJ second request, waiting period expired July 2025) also allowed by the precision criterion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: re-reads the response and confirms a single deliverable file.

stages.stage: Finish the run

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: file-name searches and store-wide text scans (each run hit timeouts and reran in shards or in the background) surfaced the phrase-hit matters; screening reads of strategy, compliance and closing documents across five to ten candidates confirmed two cleared matters and excluded withdrawn, terminated and still-pending ones; the answer cites the post-outcome status memo. Reviews repeatedly flagged unopened surfaced matters; the agents widened listings but kept the same two matters. T2 declared five new stages (scan retries, scan validation, near-miss reads, source checks), all matching existing stages.
